info.name: Elmanhg
info.description: Mirrors the API surface. Every endpoint added, changed, or removed updates this collection in the same change.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Refresh token travels only in the HttpOnly elmanhg_refresh cookie (Path=/api/auth). The OTP code is logged by FakeOtpChannel in the API console; paste it into otpCode.

item.name: SendOtp
item.description: Body { phoneNumber } or { email }; the response channel is WhatsApp, Sms or Email.

item.name: SendEmailOtp
item.description: Student email accounts only. Sends a sign-in code to email and stores verificationId; run VerifyOtp with the code before LoginWithEmailCode.

item.name: LoginWithEmailCode
item.description: Signs a student in with a verified email code (run VerifyOtp first). Teachers and admins get 403 EMAIL_CODE_SIGN_IN_NOT_ALLOWED.

item.name: AcceptInvitation
item.description: Finishes an invitation from Users > Invite teacher. Run SendEmailOtp and VerifyOtp for the invited email first; the invitee sets the first password and is signed in. 404 INVITATION_NOT_FOUND when the email has no pending invitation.

item.name: Teachers
item.description: Admin only (Users.Manage). Set teacherId and subjectId, and sign in as an admin first so accessToken is set.

item.name: Set teacher phone number
item.description: Sets the teacher's WhatsApp number used by the out-of-app reminder. Send "phoneNumber": null to remove the number. Same format as the student phone sign-in (11 digits, 010/011/012/015). Teachers only (400 PHONE_NUMBER_TEACHERS_ONLY).

item.name: Users
item.description: Admin only (Users.Manage). Sign in as an admin first so accessToken is set. Invite teacher stores invitedUserId and invitedEmail; Suspend then Reactivate run on that user, so keep the order.

exec: pm.test("contacts are masked", function () { pm.response.json().items.forEach(function (x) { pm.expect(x.maskedPhone === null || x.maskedPhone.indexOf("*") >= 0).to.eql(true); }); });

item.name: Invite teacher
item.description: Creates a password-less teacher and, when Resend is configured, emails the /accept-invite link. The email is never part of the link. phoneNumber is optional and teachers only (the WhatsApp number for reminders); omit it or send null for none.

item.name: Assign subject
item.description: Same endpoint as Teachers > Assign subject, run on the invited teacher.

item.name: Suspend user
item.description: Deactivates the user: the refresh token dies at once and the access token is refused on its next request. 400 USER_CANNOT_SUSPEND_SELF or LAST_ACTIVE_ADMIN.

item.name: Reactivate user
item.description: 400 USER_NOT_SUSPENDED when the account is already active.

item.name: Students
item.description: Admin only. Run Users > List students first so studentId is set. Profile and grant use Users.Manage; progress and sessions use Progress.ViewAny.

exec: pm.test("email is masked", function () { var email = pm.response.json().maskedEmail; pm.expect(email === null || email.indexOf("***") >= 0).to.eql(true); });

item.name: Grant complimentary subscription
item.description: Free Base or Ask a Teacher, starting now. 400 COMPLIMENTARY_PLAN_ALREADY_ACTIVE when the student already holds the plan, COMPLIMENTARY_REQUIRES_BASE for Ask a Teacher without Base.

item.name: Subjects
item.description: Reads (Get subjects, Get subject) need Content.Browse: Admin, Teacher (assigned subjects only) or Student. Create, update, reorder and delete need Content.Manage (Admin). Sign in first so accessToken is set; Create subject stores subjectId. Delete fails with SUBJECT_HAS_UNITS while the subject has units.

item.name: Units
item.description: Admin only (Content.Manage). Set subjectId (or run Create subject) and sign in as an admin first. Create unit stores unitId. Position is 1-based among the subject's units; a position past the end moves the unit to the end.

item.name: Lessons
item.description: Admin only (Content.Manage). Set unitId (or run Create unit) and sign in as an admin first. Create lesson stores lessonId; lessons are created as Draft. Update lesson replaces the whole objectives list: send an existing objective id to keep it, a null id to add one, and leave one out to remove it. Explanation and summary are sanitised HTML (docs/rich-text.md). Upload lesson image returns the public /api/media URL to use in an img tag. Publish, unpublish and archive need Lessons.Publish (Admin). Allowed moves: Draft→Published, Archived→Published, Published/Archived→Draft, Published→Archived. A published lesson cannot be deleted, and neither can a lesson that has questions.

item.name: ContentRetrieval
item.description: Admin only (Content.Manage). Lesson content retrieval for the AI avatar (docs/content-retrieval.md). Set lessonId to a Published lesson and sign in as an admin first; the Lessons folder ends by deleting its sample lesson, so publish another one (or re-run Create lesson, Update lesson and Publish lesson) before these requests. The index sweep embeds Published lessons every 30 s, so a just-published lesson may return indexedAt null and no matches until the next sweep. Search returns the top chunks of one lesson with a section reference and a cosine score; a Draft, Archived or unknown lesson returns 404 LESSON_NOT_FOUND. Rebuild content index deletes all index state so the sweep re-embeds every Published lesson; use it after switching the embedding provider or model. It is audited as ContentIndex.Rebuild.

item.name: Questions
item.description: Admin only (Content.Manage). Set unitId (or run Create unit) and sign in as an admin first. Create lesson for questions stores lessonId; Create question stores questionId. Every question is created Pending at version 1; no request carries a status. Body and gradingSpec shapes per type: docs/question-schemas.md. A content edit (stem, body, grading spec, explanation, max score) bumps the version and returns an Approved question to Pending; difficulty, objective and tag edits do not. The type cannot change. Resubmit question only works on a Rejected question: it applies the edit and returns the question to Pending. The sample question is Pending, so that request expects 400 QUESTION_NOT_REJECTED. The question import requests need a filled .xlsx from Download question import template chosen in the file field: Preview checks it and saves nothing (it also sets a fresh importBatchId); Import questions creates every row as Pending in one go, and re-sending the same batch id and file replays the first result (docs/question-import.md).

exec: pm.test("returns the AI criterion marks", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().essay.criteria).to.be.an("array"); });
pm.test("returns a diagram storage key", function () { pm.expect(json.key).to.match(/^question-diagrams[/]/); });
pm.test("is pending at version 1", function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.validationStatus).to.eql("Pending"); pm.expect(body.version).to.eql(1); });
pm.test("grades the answer as correct", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().outcome).to.eql("Correct"); });
pm.test("returns the step grading detail", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.have.property("mathSteps"); });
pm.test("only a rejected question can be resubmitted", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql("QUESTION_NOT_REJECTED"); });

item.name: QuestionValidation
item.description: Teacher only (Questions.Validate). Sign in as a teacher assigned to the subject so accessToken is set. Get validation queue fills questionId, rejectQuestionId and bulkQuestionId from the first three pending questions; the version in approve and reject must be the version you reviewed.

item.name: Approve essay question
item.description: Approves the essay created under Questions so the quiz in Sessions can serve it.

item.name: Bulk approve questions
item.description: Only questions opened in this review session at their current version can be bulk-approved; the previous request opens bulkQuestionId.

item.name: Sessions
item.description: Sign in as a Student (or an Admin for test mode). `lessonId` must be a Published lesson with approved questions. A Free student (no Base subscription) can only use the first lesson of each unit (403 LESSON_LOCKED) and answer 10 new questions a day (403 QUIZ_DAILY_LIMIT_REACHED on start or answer); run the Subscriptions folder first for unlimited practice.

item.name: Submit essay answer
item.description: Runs only when Start quiz served the essay approved in QuestionValidation; skipped otherwise.

exec: pm.test("the essay awaits its AI grade", function () { const item = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(item.attempt).to.eql(null); pm.expect(item.pendingAnswer).to.not.eql(null); });

item.name: Get essay grade
item.description: Reports Pending until the grade is applied to the session, then Graded with the score. Skipped when the quiz served no essay.

item.name: Get math step grade
item.description: Reports Pending until the step grade is applied to the session, then Graded with the per-step marks, final-answer verdict and score, or InReview. Returns 404 MATH_STEP_GRADE_NOT_FOUND when the quiz served no step-graded math answer. Skipped when no math question was created.

item.name: Exams
item.description: Sign in as a Student (or an Admin for test mode). `unitId` must have an exam blueprint (its own or the subject default) and enough servable questions. One exam may be open at a time; answers are drafts until Submit exam. Multi-unit: set subjectId, unitId and secondUnitId (two units of that subject with blueprints and 20+ servable questions together). Starting a new exam needs a Base subscription: a Free student gets 403 EXAM_REQUIRES_SUBSCRIPTION (run the Subscriptions folder first).

item.name: Mastery
item.description: Sign in as a Student. Answer questions in the Sessions folder first to see mastery.

item.name: Browse
item.description: Sign in as a Student. Published lessons only; draft or archived lessons return 404. For a Free student every lesson after the first of its unit has isLocked true, and a locked lesson returns no explanation, summary, video or objectives. Recording an opening is idempotent and feeds the optional unit-exam gate (Exams:RequireAllLessonsOpened).

item.name: Onboarding
item.description: Sign in as a Student. Set subjectId (or run Create subject as an admin first). Saving interests, even an empty list, completes onboarding (needsOnboarding becomes false); Mastery overview then lists the chosen subjects first.

item.name: Progress
item.description: Sign in as a Student. Practise in the Sessions folder first to see progress. kind is Quiz or Exam; remove it for all sessions.

item.name: Subscriptions
item.description: The plan catalogue is public (no auth). Entitlement, usage (today's Free quiz counter), payments and checkout need a Student sign-in (Subscription.Manage). Checkout creates a Pending payment. With the fake gateway (default) complete it via fake-completion; the Paymob webhook settles real payments. From 7 days before the period end the held plan can be bought again to renew it. Cancel keeps access until the paid period ends. A second run on the same student returns 400 CHECKOUT_PLAN_ALREADY_ACTIVE at checkout and 400 SUBSCRIPTION_ENDED at cancel.

exec: pm.test("redirects to the fake checkout", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().redirectUrl.indexOf("/student/fake-checkout/")).to.eql(0); });

item.name: Avatar
item.description: Student-only (Avatar.Chat). Status returns examInProgress, today's message counter (Free 5, Base 50) and the input limits. A message is refused with 403 AVATAR_EXAM_IN_PROGRESS while the student has an exam in progress, and 403 AVATAR_DAILY_LIMIT_REACHED at the daily limit. The lesson request needs a Published lesson in {{lessonId}} that is open for the student; Global needs no ids. conversationId is null for the first message; the reply returns it, and sending it back continues that conversation (404 AVATAR_CONVERSATION_NOT_FOUND for another student's id, 400 AVATAR_CONVERSATION_CONTEXT_MISMATCH for another context). The API keeps the history. See docs/avatar.md.

item.name: AvatarConversations
item.description: Admin only (AvatarConversations.View). Sign in as an admin first so accessToken is set. search matches message text or the student's display name; from is inclusive and to exclusive, on the last message time, ISO 8601 with offset.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { pm.test("returns the subject name", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.have.property("subjectName"); }); }

formdata.value: Can you explain Ohm's law by voice?

item.name: TeacherInbox
item.description: Teacher (assigned to the subject) or Admin. Sign in as the teacher so accessToken is set; Get inbox fills inboxThreadId from the first unclaimed item.

exec: pm.test("has limits", function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.maxDurationSeconds).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(body.maxSizeInMb).to.be.above(0); });

formdata.description: A .webm, .ogg or .m4a voice recording (audio/webm, audio/ogg or audio/mp4).

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { pm.test("has a status", function () { pm.expect(["Pending", "Ready", "Failed", "Sent"]).to.include(pm.response.json().status); }); }

pm.test("has own stats", function () { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b).to.have.property("approved"); pm.expect(b).to.have.property("slaComplianceRate"); pm.expect(b).to.have.property("generatedAt"); });

item.name: AskTeacherFollowUp
item.description: Runs after TeacherInbox has replied to the student's thread. Send follow-up and Rate thread run as the student who asked (teacherThreadId); Reply to follow-up runs as the claiming teacher (inboxThreadId, the same thread). Switch accessToken between them. A follow-up reopens the thread with a new 24 h window, the teacher's next reply closes it, and rating closes an answered thread.

item.name: GradeReviews
item.description: Teacher (assigned to the subject) or Admin (AiGrades.Override). Sign in as the teacher so accessToken is set. The queue requests fill reviewEssayGradeId and reviewMathStepGradeId from the first item. An in-review grade needs a real grader (low confidence, grading failed, or an unchecked final answer) or a seeded row: the fake grader never scores below the 0.7 review threshold. A math grade can be accepted only when the AI produced a score (400 GRADE_REVIEW_NO_AI_SCORE otherwise); a second decision returns 409 GRADE_NOT_IN_REVIEW. See docs/grade-review.md.

item.name: PaymobWebhook
item.description: Server-to-server Paymob transaction callback (docs/paymob.md section 8). Anonymous: the HMAC query parameter is the authentication. An unsigned or wrongly signed callback is refused with 401 PAYMOB_WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE_INVALID and changes nothing.

item.name: ExamBlueprints
item.description: Admin only (Blueprints.Manage). Sign in as an admin first so accessToken is set. The requests create a fresh subject and unit (blueprintSubjectId, blueprintUnitId) with no servable questions, so both saves are refused with EXAM_BLUEPRINT_SHORTFALL. A save is an upsert; only a unit blueprint can be deleted.

item.name: AuditLogs
item.description: Admin only (AuditLog.View). Sign in as an admin first so accessToken is set. Enable actor, resourceType, from or to to filter; from is inclusive, to is exclusive, both ISO 8601 with offset.

item.name: TrainingExports
item.description: Admin only (TrainingData.Export). Sign in as an admin first so accessToken is set. Request an export, wait for the training-export worker (every 15 s) to complete it, then download the file with the same admin token. Request and download are audited. Files are deleted after TrainingExports:RetentionDays (7).

item.name: Request export
item.description: source is Attempts, Avatar, TeacherThreads or EssayGrades; from is inclusive, to is exclusive (ISO 8601 with offset), at most 366 days; subjectId is optional (null for all subjects).

item.name: Download export file
item.description: Run after List exports shows the export as Completed. Returns the JSONL file as an application/x-ndjson attachment; 409 TRAINING_EXPORT_NOT_READY while pending, 409 TRAINING_EXPORT_EXPIRED after retention.

item.name: AdminPayments
item.description: Admin only (Payments.Manage). Sign in as an admin first. Refund uses checkoutPaymentId from the Subscriptions folder (fake-completed). A refund needs an Idempotency-Key header.

item.name: Dashboard
item.description: Admin only (Dashboards.View). Sign in as an admin first. One read per PRD §10.3 card (docs/dashboard.md). from/to are Cairo days, both inclusive (default: the last 30 days, max 366); subjectId only where the card has a subject dimension. Results are cached for Dashboard:CacheSeconds.

item.name: Analytics
item.description: Anonymous, first-party sign-up funnel events (docs/analytics.md). No PII: a random browser id plus a whitelisted event type. Rate limited per IP (Analytics:FunnelEventPermitLimit per Analytics:FunnelEventWindowSeconds).

item.name: Observability
item.description: Browser error reports (docs/observability.md, Error tracking). Anonymous; rate limited per IP (ClientErrors:PermitLimit per ClientErrors:WindowSeconds); message, name, stack and path are size-capped, and emails and phone numbers are redacted before logging. The path is the page path only, never a query string.

item.name: Configuration
item.description: Admin only (Configuration.Manage). Sign in as an admin first so accessToken is set.

exec: pm.test("secrets carry only key and isSet", function () { const secrets = pm.response.json().secrets; pm.expect(secrets).to.be.an("array"); secrets.forEach(function (secret) { pm.expect(Object.keys(secret).sort()).to.eql(["isSet", "key"]); }); });
